title: Composition coherence of normalized mixed Leray comparisons
statement: For schemes X,Y,Z [def-pc-scheme], morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z and F in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], with independent sheaf and module localization universes, write RΓ for derived global sections [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], c_h for the normalized mixed Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso], e(f,g) for the typed normalized direct-image composition comparison [lem-sc-derived-direct-image-square-mate] [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition], and s(f,g) for restriction along a composite [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison]. Then c_g(Rf_*F);S_g(c_f(F))=RΓ_Z(e(f,g)_F);c_(f;g)(F);s(f,g)_(RΓ_X F). This concerns one composable path and does not assert any pullback-square mate identity.

proof.text: Form the two natural transformations whose components are the two sides. Choose a K-injective resolution I and an isomorphism F ≅ Qh(quotient I), using DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective and quotientCompQhIso. Postcompose both components at F with the target functor image of this isomorphism; cancellation and the two naturality equations reduce to the equality at Qh(quotient I). Apply the coherence calculation restricted to the K-injective complex I.

proof_origin.note: Second reading supplies the complete Lean resolution/naturality transport and restricts the remaining unit calculation to K-injective complexes. One upper hole closed, one strictly lower representative hole added: decomposition, net zero, not an axiom-free proof.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedSections_composition_coherence
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    let e : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ g) :=
      schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso f g
    (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj F) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
          ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).hom.app F) =
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Z).map (e.hom.app F) ≫
        (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (f ≫ g)).hom.app F ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestrictionCompIso f g).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).obj F)
